example_sentences_in_bangla: তার গতর দেখে মনে হয় সে খুব সুস্থ।
example_sentences_in_english: Looking at his back, he seems very healthy.
Maintaining one's health is tough at this age.
note: The idiom uses 'গতর' (back) to metaphorically assess overall physical condition, common in rural or semi-urban Bengali speech.
